name: 映像ブロック化解析
mechanism:
This method analyzes video blockiness artifacts for forensic detection:

1. **ブロック境界検出**: Block coding boundaries (typically 8×8 or 16×16 pixels for H.264/H.265) are detected by measuring intensity discontinuities at these regular intervals. The strength of block boundaries quantifies blockiness.

2. **Blockiness分布分析**: The spatial distribution of blockiness across the frame is analyzed. Natural single-encoded video shows blockiness correlated with content complexity and QP allocation. Re-encoded video (after manipulation) may show double-blockiness patterns or blockiness distribution inconsistent with the current QP map.

3. **顔-BackgroundBlockiness比較**: Blockiness characteristics should be consistent across the frame from a single encoding pass. The method compares blockiness in face regions vs. background. Deepfakes compositing a separately encoded/generated face may show different blockiness characteristics between face and background.

4. **時間的Blockinessパターン**: Blockiness varies naturally with frame type (I-frames show different blockiness than P/B-frames). The method analyzes temporal blockiness patterns — they should follow the GOP structure predictably. Anomalous temporal blockiness patterns indicate manipulation or re-encoding.

5. **ブロックMisalignment検出**: If video has been cropped, resized, or reframed (common in deepfake processing), the coding block grid may be misaligned with the original grid, creating "grid shift" detectable as double block boundaries at offset positions at the grid misalignment.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 周波数
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through 動画 blockiness analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
